The '''Kessel Bunker''' was a [[laboratory]] off the [[planet]] [[Kessel]]<ref name="CC" /> in the [[Kessel system]] in the [[Kessel sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> Sometime between [[5 BBY]] and [[4 BBY]],<ref name="CC date">{{ChopperChaseDate}}</ref> the Empire began testing biological weapons in the lab. When rumors spread of the event, the [[Spectres]] traveled to the lab where they [[Mission to steal Imperial research crates|stole]] some crates.<ref name="CC" />
